verdict.rationale: Postman's Agent Mode is documented as turning natural-language instructions into actions across the API lifecycle: sending requests, fixing errors, updating tests, visualizing responses and writing documentation (postman-docs-8, postman-docs-33). Postbot is a first-party AI assistant, though free use is capped at 50 activities per user per month and team-wide use needs a paid add-on (postman-docs-48, postman-docs-59). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably, in-depth docs on the full scope of operations Agent Mode can perform, and full natural-language use without usage caps or paid add-ons.
